dialogues.speaker: Inkanak
dialogues.text: Welcome back to the Flower-Feather Clan. Everything's going well here!

dialogues.speaker: Inkanak
dialogues.text: We were in a rough spot before, but good thing we had formidable folks like you and Chasca around — it all worked out in the end.

dialogues.speaker: Inkanak
dialogues.text: I also get that some of my proposals are a little too focused on efficiency over safety...

dialogues.speaker: Inkanak
dialogues.text: But somehow, they always wind up getting picked up and implemented by people like yourself, so I guess I'm just lucky like that.

dialogues.speaker: Inkanak
dialogues.text: Are you saying that it's human nature to tackle challenges head-on?
